notes:
Company snapshot: LumenField AI builds a technician-facing conversational assistant for field service teams. Mid-market (250 engineers + ops). Wants low-latency streaming chat with safe tool-calls (inventory lookup, scheduling).

High-level requirements:
- Workload: multi-turn chat agent + async tool-calls to proprietary inventory API and search index. Embeddings for document lookup as secondary.
- Latency SLOs: target p50 <= 150ms for streaming tokens on common flows, p95 < 400ms; p99 target discussed for Dedicated. Must measure end-to-end (model + network + tool call).
- Throughput: peak 120 concurrent agent sessions; estimated 5M tokens/month currently, growth to 20M in 12 months. Cost sensitive but prioritizes UX.
- Quality controls: need prompt/eval regression gating. Will run weekly evals on core prompt suite (200 prompts) and require automatic regression alerts tied to deploys. Wants A/B experiments + 5% canary rollout before ramp.
- Ops: need per-route tracing, token breakdown, and quick fallback to smaller model for burst scenarios. Interested in intelligent batching, prefix/KV cache to reduce token cost without increasing tail latency.

Security & compliance:
- SSO (SAML) mandatory; audit logs and KMS integration required for Dedicated/Private. Data residency: primary NA region, may require EU residency for some enterprise customers.

POC notes (hosted API):
- POC scope: validate streaming latency for 3 representative flows (simple Q/A, multi-turn troubleshooting, tool-call flow). Measure p50/p95/p99 with model variants and quantify token cost.
- Observations so far: streaming looks promising for p50 on short responses (~120-160ms depending on network). Tool-call orchestration adds ~80-200ms depending on remote API; exploring local caching of inventory responses.
- Prompt gating: plan to surface top-5 regression examples and hook into their CI for pre-rollout checks. Want SDK hooks for canary routing and traffic split.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If streaming can't hit ~150ms median on our common flows, the UX degrades — that's non-negotiable." — Head of Product (Ana Ramos)
